research_question: Can independently learned static-strength knowledge improve prediction of chemically and publication-disjoint fatigue life for data-poor multi-principal-element alloys when the borrowed strength is used through a physics-aligned stress-normalization contract?
selection_history: The donor-to-recipient edge was selected after earlier MPEA strength and unrelated cross-domain results had been inspected. No numeric fatigue-life or stress-amplitude values from the recipient workbook were inspected before this design was frozen. Workbook sheet names, headers, and the outcome-free parameter worksheet were inspected to establish feasibility.
claim_guard: A passing result establishes one retrospective, outcome-unseen, cross-database mechanical borrowing edge. It does not establish prospective alloy discovery, universal fatigue transfer, or a general law relating monotonic strength to fatigue.

recipient.name: FatigueData-CMA2022
recipient.primary_outcome: log10 fatigue life in cycles for failure observations
recipient.censored_secondary: run-out-aware concordance using all eligible S-N observations

birdshot_uts.role: independent composition-only support card and disagreement diagnostic

preoutcome_gate.decision: Do not read numeric fatigue outcomes or submit a formal job if any gate fails.

provenance_contract.outer_group: connected component of recipient DOI and canonical composition
provenance_contract.recipient_measured_uts_or_ys_role: oracle ceiling and semantic validation only

ood_design.hard_ood: components in the highest quartile of nearest-source composition distance, reported only if at least five independent components qualify
ood_design.applicability: Borrowing may act only where the recipient composition is within the frozen source-support threshold and source-model disagreement is below its donor-only 90th percentile; otherwise the policy falls back to target-only.

borrowed_static_strength: log10 stress amplitude minus predicted log10 UTS
predicted maximum stress divided by predicted UTS
secondary_joint_uts_ys: log10 stress amplitude minus predicted log10 YS
feature_contracts.safe_router: Use borrowed_static_strength only inside the frozen applicability region; otherwise return the target-only prediction.

models.source_size_rule: Deterministically size-match UTS, hardness, and elongation donors to the smallest eligible post-DOI-exclusion source; the frozen metadata-only count is 530 rows.

inference.bootstrap: hierarchical cluster bootstrap over connected components and whole fatigue curves
inference.multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction over the four primary contrasts
